chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 137: The Sword – Li Huowang’s New Weapon & Jingxin’s Price
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang visits Abbess Jingxin at Anci Nunnery, bringing pastries as thanks. He walks away with a military-grade sword soaked in killing intent—and a quietly terrifying promise.
og_description: Li Huowang pays a debt of gratitude—and incurs a far stranger one—when Abbess Jingxin gifts him a sword that could drive an ordinary man mad.
twitter_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 137 – A sword that kills men *and* spirits, for the low price of thirty thousand taels of gold (plus one future secret).
twitter_description: Li Huowang’s new blade comes with a side of murderous intent and a promise he can’t yet keep. The real price? A secret he hasn’t found yet.
